Each section below is one answer to a question in `exercises/04_daydream.md`.
The code is folded; click "Show the code". Copy a section into your own
report and change it.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(readr)
library(here)

programs <- readRDS(here("data", "ppd_programs.rds"))
yearly   <- readRDS(here("data", "ppd_yearly.rds"))
inst_tbl <- read_csv(here("data", "institutions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

inst   <- programs %>% filter(unitid == params$unitid)
me     <- inst$opeid6[1]
my_nm  <- inst$instnm[1]
my_st  <- inst$stabbr[1]
current <- inst %>% filter(exists_in_2024_or_2025 == 1)
tested  <- current %>% filter(earnings_test != "Not tested")
```

## 1. Who is at risk? Programs within 10 percent of the benchmark

```{r}
#| label: at-risk
tested %>%
  filter(abs(earnings_margin_pct) <= 0.10) %>%
  arrange(earnings_margin_pct) %>%
  select(credlev, cip4_title, t4enrl_prg_2025, md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb, earnings_margin_pct, earnings_test) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(credlev = "Level", cip4_title = "Program", t4enrl_prg_2025 = "Enrolled",
             md_earn_wne_p4 = "Earnings", earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb = "Benchmark",
             earnings_margin_pct = "Margin", earnings_test = "Result") %>%
  fmt_number(t4enrl_prg_2025, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_currency(c(md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_percent(earnings_margin_pct, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Within ten percent of the line, either side")
```

## 2. Which benchmark was each program held to?

```{r}
#| label: which-test
tested %>%
  count(credlev, which_test_cip2_wageb) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = credlev, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "which_test_cip2_wageb") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Benchmark applied, by credential level",
             subtitle = "Undergraduate programs face the high school median; graduate programs face bachelor's holders in the field")
```

## 3. Ten years of Pell, as a share of Title IV enrollment

```{r}
#| label: pell-trend
#| fig-height: 4
yearly %>%
  filter(opeid6 == me) %>%
  group_by(award_year, credlev) %>%
  summarise(pell = sum(pell_stu_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            enrl = sum(t4enrl_prg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(enrl > 0) %>%
  mutate(share = pell / enrl) %>%
  ggplot(aes(award_year, share, colour = credlev)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:2025) +
  labs(x = "Award year (ending)", y = "Pell recipients / Title IV students", colour = NULL,
       title = paste("Pell share of Title IV enrollment,", my_nm)) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## 4. Debt against earnings, one point per program

```{r}
#| label: debt-earn
#| fig-height: 5
current %>%
  filter(!is.na(debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn), !is.na(md_earn_wne_p4)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn, md_earn_wne_p4, colour = credlev, size = t4enrl_prg_2025)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar()) +
  scale_size_continuous(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Median debt at completion (2019 dollars)", y = "Median earnings, four years out (2024 dollars)",
       colour = NULL, title = "Below the dashed line, graduates owe more than they earn in a year") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## 5. Everyone in my state: pass and fail by control

```{r}
#| label: state
programs %>%
  filter(stabbr == my_st, exists_in_2024_or_2025 == 1, earnings_test != "Not tested") %>%
  count(control, credlev, earnings_test) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = earnings_test, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(`Fail rate` = Fail / (Fail + Pass)) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "control") %>%
  fmt_percent(`Fail rate`, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_header(title = paste("Earnings test results in", my_st), subtitle = "Tested programs with current enrollment")
```

## 6. Peers, same program

```{r}
#| label: peers
peer_ids <- c(100858, 100751, 139959, 217882, 176080)
programs %>%
  filter(unitid %in% peer_ids, credlev == "Bachelor", cip4 == 5202) %>%   # 52.02 Business Administration
  select(instnm, t4enrl_prg_2025, md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb, earnings_margin, debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn) %>%
  arrange(desc(md_earn_wne_p4)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(instnm = "Institution", t4enrl_prg_2025 = "Enrolled 2024-25", md_earn_wne_p4 = "Earnings",
             earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb = "Benchmark", earnings_margin = "Margin", debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn = "Median debt") %>%
  fmt_number(t4enrl_prg_2025, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_currency(c(md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb, earnings_margin, debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn), decimals = 0) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Business Administration, bachelor's, five institutions")
```
